title_sq: Apartament 1+1 ne shitje Tek Kompleksi Malajzian ne Tirane (ID 4111850 ).
description_sq:
Tek Kompleksi Malajzian, shitet apartament 1+1, kati i 6 banim ne pallat te ri me ashensor. Apartamenti ka siperfaqe prej 70 m² neto, organizohet ne sallon te bollshem me ambjent gatimi, 1 dhome gjumi, korridor, 1 tualet, ballkon. Apartamenti shitet i mobiluar si ne foto. Apartamenti ka orientim me diell dhe ndricim natyral gjate gjithe dites. Dhe ndodhet ne nje zone te zhvilluar qe ofron akses te gjitha facilitetet e mundshme.
Cmimi 102,000 €.
title_en: 1+1 apartment for sale at the Malaysian Complex in Tirana (ID 4111850).
description_en: At the Malaysian Complex, 1+1 apartment for sale, 6th residential floor in a new building with an elevator. The apartment has an area of ​​70 m² net, it is organized in a spacious living room with a kitchen area, 1 bedroom, corridor, 1 toilet, balcony. The apartment is sold furnished as in the photo. The apartment has a sunny orientation and natural lighting throughout the day. And it is located in a developed area that offers access to all possible facilities. Price €102,000.
